consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the 1990-07-21 show at World Amphitheatre featured strong performances, particularly in the second set, despite some criticisms of the first set. The sound quality was noted to be better on tape than at the venue, and many praised specific songs for their energy and creativity.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.3 for 38 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While many fans praised the second set and specific performances, there were notable criticisms of the first set and the venue, leading to a mixed overall sentiment.
